create_contextual_value: create a ContextualValue instance with an initial value and optional module metadata
get_contextual_value: get the current value of a ContextualValue, returning scoped value if set or global fallback
set_scoped_contextual_value: set a ContextualValue temporarily within a context manager scope, restoring the previous value on exit
set_globally_contextual_value: set a ContextualValue at the global level so it persists across all scopes
combine_exit_stack_contextual_values: combine multiple ContextualValue scoped updates using contextlib.ExitStack for conditional or batched scoping
